summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The TappAlpha Innovation 100 Growth & Daily Income ETF (TDAQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, aiming to provide a balanced approached to growth and income from US large-cap equities. The fund holds long exposure to the Nasdaq-100 Index and writes daily out-of-the-money calls, using 0DTE options TDAQ was launched on Sep 4, 2025 and is issued by TappAlpha.
